Storm face PNGs are direct 6x renders of the six-face die net on page 4 of the user's supplied `John Company Wood Manifest.pdf` (the two plain 4 faces share one image). No symbols or text were generated or inferred. Source crop rectangles, in PDF points:

- East: 248.0261, 139.5791, 294.3801, 185.9331
- West: 295.6979, 186.8291, 342.0519, 233.1831
- South: 343.3698, 139.5791, 389.7238, 185.9331
- All seas: 295.6979, 139.5791, 342.0519, 185.9331
- No storms: 295.6979, 92.3291, 342.0519, 138.6831

The regular die is drawn in CSS/SVG following that page's specified red/black marbling and WHITE pips. Its pictured sample has gold pips; the manifest explicitly says not to use gold. The marble finish is a styling approximation, not an extracted photograph. Standard d6 pip layouts are used; the manifest does not supply a regular-die net.
